name: Chinese boatpeople by a makeshift dwelling on the shore
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A boatwoman in a headscarf, with two children beside her, stands on the beach by a temporary dwelling made of rattan and bamboo; boats are sketched in the bay beyond them.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
